paper.title: Mixture Proportion Estimation and PU Learning: A Modern Approach
paper.target: alpha_U: positive fraction in marginal unlabeled mixture, not generic OS population pi
paper.bbe_location: Algorithm 1, printed page 4; accompanying upper-tail definition in section 4
paper.tedn_location: Algorithm 3, printed page 7; not implemented here
paper.return: q_U(c_hat)/q_P(c_hat), not the selection upper bound
paper.identifiability: the empirical tail-ratio target need not equal true alpha_U without the paper's pure-positive-bin/identifiability conditions

source_differences.source_value: only strict descending gaps among U scores; skips the last U entry and tied entries; requires j>1 and i>1
source_differences.toolbox_value: all distinct empirical tails from P/U union plus zero; include >= threshold ties; require only positive P tail mass
source_differences.decision: paper upper-tail semantics; do not claim pinned author-code replay

source_differences.source_value: uses zero-based i as U tail count at sorted_u_probs[i], while P count includes >= threshold
source_differences.toolbox_value: both role counts use inclusive >= threshold
source_differences.decision: paper Algorithm 1 criterion; independently transcribed scalar counting oracle in tests

source_differences.source_value: returns estimate 0 when no candidate passes filters
source_differences.toolbox_value: nonempty valid scores always admit c=0 with ratio 1; empty inputs raise
source_differences.decision: do not synthesize zero evidence from absent candidates

source_differences.source_value: requires U targets and reads them for an unused counter; the returned estimate does not depend on that counter
source_differences.decision: remove unnecessary dependency, not an allegation of alpha-label leakage in the source

source_differences.source_value: deep score transform, warm-start and per-epoch BBE for TEDn
source_differences.toolbox_value: standalone one-time PvU scoring fit, internal within-role holdout, default train-only scaling plus balanced logistic max_iter1000; cloneable supplied scoring model supported
source_differences.decision: 2-D engineering path only; no TEDn alternation, original recipe or approved formal budget

implementation.runtime_input: dense 2-D; observed y_pu roles 1=P and 0=U; explicit input_sampling=ts required
implementation.holdout_policy: ceil(holdout_fraction*n_role), independent permutation of each observed role, require both train and holdout nonempty
implementation.result_receipt: all thresholds, role counts, ratios, selection bounds, selected index and parameters
implementation.data_receipt: train/holdout input positions and role counts; optional unique string sample IDs checked; external source/group isolation remains caller responsibility

engineering_acceptance.scope: CPU synthetic contracts and packaging, not real-data prior accuracy or formal admission
